newsitem.title: USA: Dyna Group unit to market NASCAR products.
newsitem.headline: Dyna Group unit to market NASCAR products.

text.p: Dyna Group International Inc said Tuesday its Great American Products unit will expand its licensed sports product line to include NASCAR-brand merchandise.

The company said several NASCAR drivers have signed up to have their racing number and signature appear in eight product categories. The complete line of products will debut at the Super Show in Atlanta February 12-18, the company said.
Dyna Group develops and markets specialty branded pewter merchandise and licensed products.
Its shares closed up 1/8 Tuesday at 1-1/4.
